'''[[File:Get_the_Horns_newsfeed.jpg|thumb|300px]]Get the Horns''' is a Spotlight Mission featuring [[Tantrum]] that ran from July 13th to August 9th.

== Rewards ==
Instead of new relics, Relic Tickets are now rewarded for mastering missions, which can be used to purchase previous relics or new special relics.
==Chapter 1 - The Enigma==
===Go Big===
Part 1
*[[Blaster]]: ''I'm not one to be looking for double trouble, but we have to go back.''
*[[Jazz]]: ''I hear ya' man, but now?''
*[[Optimus Prime]]: ''Blaster is correct. If we do not stop Megatron now, we surely will face dire consequences. Megatron is searching for seomthing...''
*Blaster: ''Yeah, a blast from the past.''
*Jazz: ''Yo' I see what you did there. But, what is he looking for?''
*Optimus Prime:'' This planet holds many secrets... and a past shaped by the ancient Primes. I do not know what he seeks, but I do know we must hurry... before he secures the power of the Primes.''
Part 2
*[[Prowl]]: ''I'm glad Optimus finally sent me out on a mission. I was getting stir crazy back at HQ listening to Ratchet rambling on about Megatron's plans.''
*Jazz: ''But check it, Prowl, that's why we're out here. Ratchet and Optimus say Megs is cooking up something big.''
*Prowl: ''I got the debrief. They think he's searching for a game changing artifact... something Primal.''
*Jazz: ''Whatever it is, we've gotta find it first.''
Part 3
*Prowl: ''Trouble ahead... in the form of Galvatron.''
*Jazz: ''Great... just what we needed. Is he running with Megatron now, too?''
*[[Galvatron]]: ''I run with and from no-one you insipid fool. I am Galvatron... I need say no more.''
*Jazz: ''So this is just a random encounter? We good?''
*Galvatron: ''We are never good. I am Galvatron... you are a pathetic waste of metal and circuitry.''
*Prowl: ''You just said more.''
*Galvatron: ''Bah! Time for you to die!''
===Random Encounter===
Part 1
*[[Soundwave]]: ''Laserbeak has returned from his reconnaissance mission. The Commander and the Autobots continue their pursuit.''
*[[Megatron]]: ''Do I care? Hardly. Once we attain what we seek, their demise is imminent.''
*Soundwave: ''With all due respect, I cannot say I share your confidence.''
*Megatron: ''Do not pull a Starscream on me. Question me not. We're going big, and the Enigma is the key. Now, go summon Bludgeon... I have a mission for him.''
Part 2
*[[Bludgeon]]: ''Soundwave said you wanted to see me.''
*Megatron: ''Indeed I do. How would you like to get serious about ending this Autobot nuisance?''
*Bludgeon: ''I'm always serious, especially when it comes to eradicating Autobots. What do you have in mind?''
*Megatron: ''Recent revelations suggest a device of unimaginable power is nearby.''
*Bludgeon: ''Yeah? I've heard that before. Care to share a little more?''
*Megatron: ''Let's just say it's time to go big... as in Combiner big.''
*Bludgeon: ''Combiner? That would turn the tide. But, I'm not one one of those... you know... Combiner pieces.''
*Megatron: ''But you could be... if we secure The Enigma of Combination. It's almost within our grasp. Buy us some time and devastating power will be yours.''
Part 3
*Jazz: ''You sure this is the way?''
*Blaster: ''Yeah, don;t you remember? Megatron's excavation site is on this path.''
*Prowl: ''Uh, squad, we've got a slight problem.''
*Blaster: ''No, I'm telling ya', this is the route.''
*Prowl: ''That's not the problem...''
*Bludgeon: ''I am.''
==Chapter 2 - Enter the Horns==
===Bull Scrap===
Part 1
*Megatron: ''Do you believe in fate, Soundwave?''
*Soundwave: ''Fate does not equate. Why?''
*Megatron: ''Because a valuable piece of our Combiner puzzle just Spacebridged its way here. Tantrum has been spotted nearby. We need to find our way to him.''
*Soundwave: ''It would be wise to grab that bull by the horns.''
*Megatron: ''Precisely. His experience as a Combiner fits perfectly with our plans. It's time to go wrangle us a bull.''
Part 2
*Magatron: ''Tantrum, I presume?''
*[[Tantrum]]: ''You got the name right, but I don't take kindly to strangers. Who are you?''
*Megatron: ''The name is Megatron... leader of the Decepitcons.''
*Tantrum: ''Last I remember, Galvatron was boss.''
*Megatron: ''That was another time.., another reality. If you want to survive here, you'll do best to listen to me.''
*Tantrum: ''And why's that?''
*Megatron: ''Because I'm putting together something special. Something big... something that will destroy all Autobots.''
*Tantrum: ''I like the sounds of that. What do you want me to do?''
*Megatron: ''Slow the Autobots roll while I uncover the power... the power to combination!''
Part 3
*Jazz: ''What the heck is that? Looks like a mascot for one of those Earth basketball teams.''
*Blaster: ''Ah, man... you don't know him? He's the cow that likes to go kapow.''
*Tantrum: ''A COW?! Try bull. A bull that's going to teach you a harsh lesson in biology, Autobot scum!''

===Headmaster===
Part 1
*[[Motormaster]]: ''You got the call from the boss?''
*[[Mixmaster]]: ''Your boss, but yeah, I'm here. Can't hurt to listen.''
*Motormaster: ''I wonder what he has in mind.''
*Mixmaster: ''That Bludgeon guy said it was something big... something about combining forces.''
*Motormaster: ''Combining forces? Sounds like something I can get behind.''
Part 2
*Megatron: ''I assume you are wondering why I summoned you.''
*Motormaster: ''I have an idea...''
*Mixmaster: ''But why don't you fill us in?''
*Megatron: ''You both have experience being part of something bigger. I;m talking about Combiner bigger.''
*Motormaster: ''Yeah, so what? Our partners in combining aren't here. Combining isn't possible.''
*Megatron: ''Don;t be so sure. Have you heard of the Enigma of Combination? The primal device that created the very power to combine? I have reason to believe... it is here.''
*Mixmaster: ''You're saying there's a chance we could combine and crush the Autobots?''
*Megatron: ''That's what I'm saying.''
*Motormaster: ''I call head.''
*Megatron: ''You'll need to earn that.''
Part 3
*Prowl: ''Ah, great. Look who we have here, the wannabe King of the Road.''
*Motormaster: ''That's right, talk trash rent-a-cop-car. Words won't matter when you see what's in store for you.''
*Prowl: ''Is that supposed to scare us?''
*Motormaster: ''Does the power of combination scare you?''
*Prowl: ''It might, if it was a possibility.''
*Motormaster: ''Anything is possible... including your death. Step up and test the possibilities.''
==Chapter 3 - Escalation==
===Devastation===
Part 1
*Optimus Prime: ''Prowl, are our suspicions confirmed?''
*Prowl: ''Based on the way the big rig was running his mouth about the power of combination... I'd say yes.''
*Optimus Prime: ''That mean Megatron thinks he's found...''
*Ratchet: ''The Enigma of Combination.''
*Prowl: ''Which means?''
*Optimus Prime: ''Which means Megatron is going to take things to a whole new level if he gets his hand on it. by the power of Primus, we must stop him.''
Part 2
*Megatron: ''Motormaster failed to stop the Autobots.''
*Mixmaster: ''That matters not to me. More importantly, have you found the Enigma of Combination?''
*[[Megatron (ROTF)]]: ''Patience, my friend. Soundwave and Shockwave have the situation well in hand.''
*Mixmaster: ''They better. This Commander and the Autobots need to be dealt with.''
*Megatron: ''I couldn't agree more. It's time to escalate, elevate...''
*Mixmaster: ''And DEVASTATE!''
Part 3
*Optimus Prime: ''We know what you are up to, Megatron.''
*Megatron: ''Oh really? That is of little concern to me.''
*Optimus Prime: ''We will not let you get the Enigma of Combination. It is not happening.''
*Megatron: ''That is not for you to decide. Mixmaster, dispatch of these nuisances then meet me at the site.''
*Mixmaster: ''No problem. Scrapping Autobots is always a pleasure.''
===Something Else===
Part 1
*Megatron: ''You're back, feeling better? Looked like the Commander's team got the better of you.''
*Tantrum: ''It's been awhile since I locked horns with the Autobots. Next time will be different.''
*Megatron: ''I admire your enthusiasm. The time is almost upon us. Soundwave and his crew have broken through to a new chamber at the excavation site.''
*Tantrum: ''What does that mean?''
*Megatron: ''That means the end to those infernal Autobots and their human pets is at hand.''
Part 2
*Soundwave: ''Lord Megatron, I have news to report.''
*Megatron: ''So... do so.''
*Soundwave: ''Progress has been made in our excavations.''
*Megatron: ''I am aware of that. Tell me something I don't know.''
*Soundwave: ''Shockwave believes our search for the Enigma may be in vain. The chamber we located was not an artifact.''
*Megatron: ''You're testing my patience.''
*Soundwave: ''We believe it was a stasis chamber. One with inhabitants... ancient inhabitants.''
*Megatron: ''Now this is an interesting turn of events. So no Enigma of Combination?''
*Soundwave: ''It is too early to tell affirmatively, but we surmise this could be something... or someone... far more powerful. Shouldn't you tell Tantrum?''
*Megatron: ''Why? He's a pawn that got played. He'll learn soon enough.''
Part 3
*Jazz: ''Looks like someone wants a rematch.''
*Blaster: ''Don't they ever learn?''
*Tantrum: ''I've learned something. I've learned I like to kick Autobot tailpipe.''
*Jazz: ''Funny, that's not how things played out last time.''
*Blaster: ''Ah, give the guy a break, Jazz... second time's a charm.''
